title: Optimization Advisory Gatekeeping & Routing Playbook
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Goal: Create a repeatable gatekeeping and routing playbook for incoming optimization/advisory requests (batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, routing policies) so enterprise customers and self-serve users get timely, consistent outcomes and the right teams are engaged with minimal friction.

Problem: Requests arrive via support tickets, sales, account execs, and Slack with varying completeness. Engineering time is frequently consumed by low-value ask-and-answer threads. We need a mechanism to quickly classify impact, allocate resources, and either resolve via self-serve guidance or route to Solutions Eng / Applied ML / Runtime teams for deeper work.

Scope: Define intake form fields, numeric scoring rubric, lane definitions and thresholds, SLA targets for triage, automation rules to tag and route, handoff artifacts, telemetry to measure throughput and lead time.

Out of scope: Billing changes, Dedicated capacity provisioning, or customized SLA contracts (handled by Enterprise Sales).
acceptance_criteria: Production intake form (Typeform or internal form) collects required fields and maps to scorecard
Automated routing rules implemented in ticketing system to assign to lane and notify POCs
Scoring rubric documented and validated with 3 pilot customer requests
Backlog dashboard shows count by lane, median time-to-triage, and time-to-resolution
Handoff checklist and templates (PRD, experiment plan, security checklist) published in Confluence
steps: Draft intake form with mandatory fields: customer tier, latency/cost baseline, sample prompts, error/quality examples, SLOs, data constraints, business outcome
Define scoring rubric and threshold values for lanes (self-serve / concierge / engineering deep-dive / enterprise project)
Prototype automation mapping in Zendesk/Linear with tags created from form responses
Run 2-week pilot with Solutions Eng and 5 inbound requests to calibrate thresholds
Publish playbook, train stakeholders (CSEs/AE/Support), and iterate based on metrics
scoring_rubric: Business impact (0-5): revenue/latency/blocked customers; >=4 pushes to higher lane
Reproducibility (0-5): can engineering reproduce issue with provided artifacts; low reproducibility lowers priority
Cost delta (0-5): projected per-token or infra savings from optimization; >=3 qualifies for advisory lane
Engineering effort (0-5): estimated FTE-weeks for a fix/tuning; >=4 moves to Engineering Deep-Dive
Regulatory/privacy risk (0-5): presence of regulated data raises required approvals and can escalate lane
lanes: Self-serve (score 0-6): provide targeted KB article, recommended knob combos, and example prompts
Concierge advisory (score 7-11): Solutions Eng + runtime playbook; 1:1 tuning session, config suggestions, runbook entry
Engineering deep-dive (score 12-16): Applied ML + Runtime; experiments, quantization profile proposals, kernel scheduling changes
Enterprise project (score 17-25): multi-week engagement with dedicated capacity, contract changes, and PM-led delivery
sla_targets: Initial triage & lane assignment: 3 business days
Concierge advisory response w/ next steps: 5 business days
Engineering deep-dive kickoff: within 10 business days of triage
Enterprise project proposal: within 15 business days
handoff_checklist: Baseline telemetry links (Console dashboard token-level latency/cost + example trace)
Current model + config (batching/caching settings, quantization used)
Desired success criteria and rollout plan
Security & data handling notes and appropriate approvals (if regulated)
automation_rules_notes: Map form fields to Linear labels: 'batching' -> label:optimization-batching; 'quantization' -> label:quantization-eval
If customer_tier == enterprise and business_impact >=4 then auto-assign to "Solutions Eng" queue
Score thresholds set in an automation script run daily to re-evaluate open tickets
Email templates generated per lane to set expectations and collect missing artifacts
metrics_to_track: Average engineering hours per advisory resolved
Regression rate after proposed quantization/knob changes
